tests.credibleRegression: a deleted profile: an interactive chat falls back to Global with a notice naming it; an unattended one fails to start
tests.independentOracle: Literal authored Editor/Developer native kits, stable conversation cursor, profile binding, explicit refusal categories and absence of Global launch on unattended/error paths.
tests.stableSeam: real daemon → host → adapter launch and native prepared configuration
tests.refactorResistance: Checks semantic launch/status/error or native persisted artifacts through existing public boundaries. New synchronization contains no fixed poll counts or sleeps and no replacement production test flag.
tests.uniqueProtection: This declared end-to-end lifetime/agent scenario composes real stores, lifecycle, host launch refresh and provider inputs; builder/resolver units cannot prove that composition.
tests.implementedChange: Shared makeProfile waits for real ensureReady calls for supported default accounts and public gc. Restart/edit waits for all default-agent readiness; deleted/failing launches use their normal production refusal behavior. Teardown awaits public gc before stopping; no test-only drain remains.
